name: Mixed Sprout Curry
ingredients: 1 tsp coriander powder, ¼ tsp turmeric, ½ tsp chilli powder and ½ tsp garam masala
steps: Heat the oil, crackle the cumin, and cook the onion, ginger and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the sprouts and 1 cup water; cover and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
Finish with garam masala, lemon juice, salt and coriander.
note: Cook sprouts thoroughly rather than eating them raw, particularly for children, older people and pregnancy.
